jobs.name: KitSheetCoral
jobs.prompt: Using the attached castle concept as the exact style and design reference, draw a clean prop sheet of separate game props taken from it, arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with lots of empty space between them. Each prop is whole, isolated, centered in its own quarter, three-quarter view from slightly above, on a plain light gray background, even studio lighting, no ground, no shadows, no castle walls, no text or labels. Match the reference exactly: stylized semi-realistic low-poly Roblox game assets, smooth shading, solid color regions. Top left: a tall spiral seashell spire roof in pearly teal with a gold rim at its base, made to sit on top of a round castle tower. Top right: a branching coral cluster in pink, orange and teal growing from a flat rock base. Bottom left: a giant open clam-shell brazier on a short stone pedestal, holding a glowing teal flame. Bottom right: a rock covered in glowing teal sea anemones, small coral and a starfish.
